paper.title: FreeBindCraft PyRosetta-free de novo binder design

generators.name: FreeBindCraft binder design
generators.description: Hallucinate a mini-protein binder against a fixed target with AlphaFold2, refine with ProteinMPNN, and validate with AF2 initial guess (PyRosetta-free BindCraft alternative).

evidence.quote: Design a mini-protein binder against a fixed target structure (PDB). PyRosetta-free pipeline already wrapped in Proto.

constraints.name: structure ipTM filter
constraints.description: Require predicted binder-target interface confidence above threshold.

evidence.quote: Constraints | structure-iptm, structure-ipae, structure-plddt, pyrosetta-interface (optional), structure-rmsd

constraints.name: structure interface PAE
constraints.description: Limit AF2 binder interface predicted aligned error.

evidence.quote: Sai fusion target: AF2 / structure validation per candidate.

constraints.name: structure pLDDT filter
constraints.description: Require predicted binder pLDDT above developability threshold.

constraints.name: structure RMSD filter
constraints.description: Penalize large RMSD drift of the predicted complex from the apo target structure.

constraints.name: PyRosetta interface score
constraints.description: Optional Rosetta interface metrics when PyRosetta is available locally.

constraints.name: protein length range
constraints.description: Keep binder within the configured mini-protein length window.

optimizers.name: rejection sampling design filter
optimizers.description: Draw independent FreeBindCraft binder candidates and keep those passing structure filters.

model_dependencies.name: FreeBindCraft
model_dependencies.purpose: PyRosetta-free AF2 hallucination + MPNN binder design

steps.operation: FreeBindCraft AF2 hallucination against frozen target
ProteinMPNN sequence assignment on binder chain
AF2 re-fold and score ipTM, ipAE, pLDDT, RMSD

assumptions: CXCR4 chain A from PDB 4RWS is a compact benchmark target shared with gpcr-cxcr4-miniprotein.
alphafold2_binder structure constraints proxy FreeBindCraft internal AF2 validation.
PyRosetta interface scoring is documented but omitted from the default builder (optional, not Modal-safe).
Rejection sampling with num_samples=50 (full) / 5 (smoke) stands in for large-scale design libraries.
unknowns: Wet-lab binding affinity and specificity are not modeled.
Exact FreeBindCraft filter thresholds may differ from Proto constraint defaults.
Target hotspot residue numbering follows PDB chain A 1-indexed positions.
